methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 high-search room air conditioner models (window and portable) spanning major brands as of mid-2026: Midea, LG, Windmill, Frigidaire Gallery, GE Profile, Hisense (x2), Toshiba, Whynter, and BLACK+DECKER. Specs were re-verified against manufacturer product pages (midea.com, lg.com, windmillair.com, frigidaire.com, geappliances.com, hisense-usa.com, toshiba-lifestyle.com, blackanddecker.com, whynter.com), the EPA Energy Star product/best-value finder (energystar.gov) for CEER and certification dates, and major retailers (Home Depot, Best Buy, Lowe's, Sylvane, Walmart) for current pricing. Adversarial re-check fixed two sources (GE corroboration moved off AJ Madison which lists a conflicting CEER; Hisense UltraSlim source moved off an obscure reseller to Best Buy) and one price (Frigidaire, unverifiable retailer). BTU values follow the DOE/SACC standard for portable units; CEER values reflect the authoritative Energy Star filing where available; noise_dba is the manufacturer-stated operating level (min for window units, max-setting where only that is published); booleans represent yes (true) or no (false); null indicates a genuinely unverified value. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Midea U+ Smart Inverter U-Shaped Window AC (MAW12U1QWT)
products.priceNote: Home Depot list price (often on sale ~$449)
products.provenance: Energy Star product finder confirms MAW12U1QWT: CEER 15.2, 12000 BTU, R-32, certified 11/17/2023. Manufacturer page confirms 32 dBA min noise, variable-speed inverter, SmartHome Wi-Fi. Coverage listed as 550 sq ft by Home Depot/Amazon/Lowe's; Midea's own page conservatively states 350 sq ft — 550 retained per retail consensus. Price $479 is the Home Depot list price (currently discounted ~$449).

products.name: LG Dual Inverter Smart Window AC (LW1222IVSM)
products.provenance: LG product page confirms 12000 BTU, 550 sq ft, 44 dB (Lo-Decibel sleep), Dual Inverter, ThinQ Wi-Fi, ~$549. Energy Star confirms CEER 15.0, R-32, certified 09/27/2023. All draft values verified unchanged.
